hooks.command: p=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); b=$(basename "$p"); if [ "$b" = ".env" ] || { [ "${b#.env.}" != "$b" ] && [ "$b" != ".env.example" ]; }; then echo "PreToolUse block: '$p' looks like an env/secret file. No credentials or .env files may be edited or committed (CLAUDE.md). Use .env.example for templates." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
